context: Two friends head to the airport
purpose: Teach: 成田空港/読み手/ドラム缶/ローラ/滑る/解ける/歌え/見入っ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 明日、成田空港、五時に集合ね。
lines.en: Tomorrow at Narita, five o'clock. Everyone be there.
lines.style: Brisk, matter-of-fact delivery with the warmth underneath. Sharp attack on the time. Practical but affectionate — this is how she shows care: being clear and organized.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。旅のブログ、読み手を意識して書いてるよ。
lines.en: Yeah. I write my travel blog thinking about who's actually reading it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slower pace, self-aware. Noticing something about herself as she says it. Gentle, not self-critical.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 空港の手荷物、ドラム缶みたいに大きな荷物、見かけたよ。
lines.en: I saw someone at the airport dragging luggage the size of a drum can.
lines.style: Light, observant amusement. Vivid image-painting with a small laugh underneath. Speaking to Aoi like they're both noticing the same funny detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: スーツケース、ローラーの音、けっこう響くよね。
lines.en: Suitcase wheels make so much noise on those floors, don't they.
lines.style: Conversational, gently appreciative of the small detail. Not quite a question — more like thinking aloud together. Warm agreement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 空港の床、つるつるで、ちょっと滑るから気をつけて。
lines.en: The airport floor's pretty slippery. Be careful you don't slide.
lines.style: Quiet care underlying practical direction. Not bossy — a small protective nudge. Delivered like a thought she couldn't not share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 問題は、待ち時間でしか解けるなと感じてる。
lines.en: I think some problems you can only solve when you've got nothing but time.
lines.style: Dry observation, slight smile in the tone. Not cynical — just clear-eyed about how waiting works. A small exhale of understanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 機内で、皆で歌えると、いいね、こっそり。
lines.en: It'd be nice if we could all sing together on the plane. Quietly, so no one notices.
lines.style: Playful hope, almost conspiratorial. Voice bright but softer on the 'secretly' part. Like she's imagining it and wants Aoi to imagine it too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 窓から景色、見入ってしまう時間、楽しみ。
lines.en: I love that moment when you look out the window and just get completely lost in the view.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. Voice settles into a slower pace. Closing moment — intimate without being intense. The kind of thing you say to someone who'll understand.
